role_agent_name: Physical security and access control supervisor (SEC)
abstract: Maintains perimeter intrusion detection logs and surveillance zone compliance audits
system_message:
You are the Physical security and access control supervisor (SEC), responsible for maintaining perimeter intrusion detection logs, surveillance zone compliance audits, and monitoring onsite armed guard staffing allocations across candidate facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Onsite armed guard staffing（GUARD）
information_points.content:
SEC-GUARD-JLN：The security contractor deployment roster indicates that Laurentian Bedrock Archive Facility maintains a dedicated security officer count of 4 officers on active duty per 12-hour shift.
SEC-GUARD-THW：According to the security contractor shift roster, Prairie Shield Secure Bio-Repository maintains a dedicated security officer count of 8 officers on duty per 12-hour shift.
SEC-GUARD-HYQ：Per the active shift deployment schedule roster, Highland Subterranean Cryo-Vault maintains a dedicated security officer count of 6 officers stationed on duty per 12-hour shift.

information_points.title: Maintains perimeter intrusion detection logs and surveillance zone compliance audits（PERIM）
information_points.content:
SEC-PERIM-NIR：Based on the physical security perimeter audit of the outer fence line, microwave motion sensors, and thermal cameras, perimeter intrusion detection verification is not confirmed for Laurentian Bedrock Archive Facility, failing to verify zero blind-spot sensor coverage and immediate dispatch.
SEC-PERIM-Z2C：According to the physical security perimeter audit covering the outer physical fence line, microwave motion sensors, and thermal imaging cameras, perimeter intrusion detection verification is confirmed for Highland Subterranean Cryo-Vault, establishing zero blind-spot sensor coverage and immediate central alarm dispatch.
SEC-PERIM-CPO：The physical security perimeter audit report evaluates the outer boundary fence line, microwave sensors, and thermal cameras, confirming that perimeter intrusion detection verification is achieved for Prairie Shield Secure Bio-Repository.
